pages.title: Unpaid
pages.text: I used to fall asleep making speeches for them. Four men in a tavern above, drinking my coin. Somewhere in this book the anger stopped filling pages.$(br2)I did not notice when.

pages.title: What I Did
pages.text: The land above is lighter now. Every grief my altars drank was taken from under it. Nobody up there knows, and that is all right.$(br2)It can heal now. Someone else will have to do the healing.

pages.title: The Eye Again
pages.text: The eye watched every trial. It looked pleased, if an eye can. I asked it once what it wanted from me. It showed me the rift, and past the rift, sky.$(br2)There is no way up through the city. The fall closed behind me. The only door left is the one it opened.

pages.title: Going
pages.text: So I am going through. I tell myself it is to get out, and it is. I tell myself it is to find four men, and maybe it is.$(br2)I leave this grimoire for whoever falls next. The debt stands. I am not finished.
